messages.subject: Ryan Lisac made a comment about your note...
messages.text:
Ryan made a comment about your note "An Open Letter to Uniontown/ A Farewell to The "Old Dan"":

"There should literally be an entire fucking blog about me... I crafted you into what you truly are... Before you met me, you were an abercrombie wearin homo, who would never say a peep... Look at you now... Cussing, swearing, wearing scarves in 90 degree weather (had nothing to do with that, but it is different, so credit), strange music from even stranger blogs from the depths of the internet, fashions from, what Uniontown would call, "a strange land named New York City".. .."I hear they have opinions there"... Anyways, I except a newly written report, on my desk in the morning, "
